name: Bazaart Photoshoot
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description: Put clothing and accessories on a model, or create clean studio product photos, from one product image. Made for online boutiques, clothing brands, and resellers who need photos for shop listings and social posts. Upload a product photo, choose a style or a Bazaart model, and pick one of nine previews. Bazaart then creates your final image to download. Connect your Bazaart account to start. Available styles and AI credit use depend on your account. Check that shape, color, and details match your real product before you post. One product at a time.

limitations_ja: Bazaartアカウントが必要。1回に1商品。
